title: Implement the orchestrator context, policy and the /kiln-start entry
statement: Build the persistent session behaviour: resolve and guard the content root, derive the current stage from definitions and attestations, load the matching skill, and register the start prompt that begins Stage 1 on a fresh project or summarises stage, blockers and the single recommended next action on an existing one.
notes: ⚠️ F87 (2026-09-13), TO BE FIXED BEFORE THE FIRST REAL ORCHESTRATOR SESSION. The handwritten `pi-package/skills/kiln-planning/SKILL.md` still says the typed tools 'are registered by later work' and are not implemented, and `pi-package/prompts/kiln-start.md` tells the session to say the tools are not registered and take no other action. Both have been false since TSK-0044 and TSK-0045 registered the tools. A session started with them would tell the operator the tools do not exist and then refuse to use them.
